rules.title: Replace engine oil
rules.summary: Replace the engine oil when the vehicle displays the main code.
rules.time_fallback_note: If the message does not appear within 12 months after reset, replace the oil annually.

rules.title: Replace oil and filter; inspect vehicle
rules.summary: Replace engine oil and filter and complete the manufacturer-listed inspections.

rules.title: Rotate tires
rules.summary: Rotate the tires and check inflation and condition.

rules.title: Replace intake and cabin filters
rules.summary: Replace the engine air-cleaner element and dust/pollen filter and inspect the drive belt.

rules.title: Replace transmission fluid
rules.summary: Replace the transmission fluid when this sub-code appears.

rules.title: Replace spark plugs; inspect valve clearance
rules.summary: Replace spark plugs and inspect valve clearance when this sub-code appears.

rules.title: Replace engine coolant
rules.summary: Replace engine coolant when this sub-code appears.

rules.title: Replace rear differential fluid
rules.summary: Replace rear differential fluid on applicable AWD vehicles when this sub-code appears.

rules.title: Replace brake fluid
rules.summary: Replace brake fluid when this sub-code appears.
rules.time_fallback_note: If the message does not appear, Honda specifies replacement every three years.
